frame: meta is ONE converging system: grit = symbol-level merge/lock substrate powering union step 2 (dedup ~95% shared handoff<->rusty-idd crates); handoff = continuity kernel + union target; rusty-idd = union target; weave = transport; harness-hub = Front-Door interpreter.

nodes.spec: Symbol-level merge/lock substrate. Powers union step 2 (dedup of the ~95% shared handoff<->rusty-idd crates: cli/core/runner/spec/tui). Substrate root.
Intent-driven development tool. Union target: its cli/core/runner/spec/tui crates dedup-merge into handoff via grit locks (gated on handoff#184).
Continuity ledger kernel (hf). Union target + dedup destination; renders packets from the witnessed ledger. Consumes grit (symbol dedup), weave (transport heartbeat), icm (persistent memory).
A2A transport / observable heartbeat for the loop. Carries relay broadcasts over the lane spine.
Infinite Context Memory: persistent cross-session recall/store substrate; uses vector embeddings from ruvector.
Front-Door interpreter: catalog/registry that routes harnesses; sits atop the continuity kernel, transport, and prompt registry. (fleet id: harness_hub; standardized to kebab-case here.)
Agentic environment manager: installs every tool/dep into meta (.toolchains), no system-global installs. Substrate root (loop run-from host).
Network/transport spine substrate. Provides the channel weave and the network-control plane compose over. Substrate root.
Prompt/model registry substrate: prompt architecture + model lanes served from shimmy. (fleet id: prompt_hub; standardized to kebab-case here.)
Local model server substrate (local inference lane). Substrate root.
Vector compute / code-intelligence substrate (fleet path: meta-ruvector). Backs icm embeddings and graph intelligence. Substrate root.

edges.reason: icm recall/store uses ruvector vector embeddings
weave transport rides the lane network spine
prompt-hub model lanes are served by shimmy
symbol-level merge/lock powers union dedup into the continuity kernel
grit dedups the ~95% shared rusty-idd crates against handoff
handoff continuity emits/observes the weave heartbeat
handoff resume hydrates persistent memory from icm
union: rusty-idd cli/core/runner/spec/tui merge into handoff via grit locks
Front-Door interpreter runs on the continuity kernel
Front-Door routes A2A traffic over weave
Front-Door resolves prompts/model lanes via prompt-hub

self_revision.trigger: grit verifier outcome on symbol-level merge feasibility / dedup ratio
self_revision.action: If grit's verifier QUALIFIES or REFUTES the symbol-level dedup spec (e.g. the ~95% shared-crate ratio is lower in practice), revise only the union dedup spec on handoff and rusty-idd; preserve weave/icm/lane/shimmy/ruvector/envctl/harness-hub nodes.
